More negative dependency_composite values mean stronger dependency; all signed estimates and intervals below are already oriented to the claimed hypothesis direction, so a signed lower bound above +0.15 was treated as evidence for a scientifically meaningful effect. SMARCA4 loss is robustly associated with stronger composite dependency: signed overall discovery estimate +0.8325, 95% lower bound +0.7667 to +0.8983 (R5), and independent validation estimate +0.7976, lower bound +0.6971 to +0.8981 (R13). TP53 loss is robustly associated with weaker composite dependency: signed overall discovery estimate +0.4232, lower bound +0.3268 to +0.5195 (R2), and independent validation estimate +0.3985, lower bound +0.2633 to +0.5336 (R39); the opposite stronger-dependency claim H2 was rejected. KEAP1 loss is robustly associated with weaker composite dependency: signed overall discovery estimate +0.8315, lower bound +0.7658 to +0.8972 (R4), and independent validation estimate +0.7648, lower bound +0.6687 to +0.8609 (R92); the opposite stronger-dependency claim H4 was rejected. MSI-high status is robustly associated with stronger composite dependency: signed overall discovery estimate +0.7918, lower bound +0.6763 to +0.9072 (R56), and independent validation estimate +0.7690, lower bound +0.5936 to +0.9443 (R78). These conclusions are associations with measured predictor status within the supplied composite-dependency dataset, not causal single-gene knockout effects, and not external biological generalization claims.\n\nThe core map is also context-presistent across many measured strata. In the newly assessed 2% serum context, TP53 loss remained associated with weaker dependency (+0.424, lower +0.190; R198), SMARCA4 loss with stronger dependency (+0.848, lower +0.680; R199), KEAP1 loss with weaker dependency (+0.910, lower +0.754; R200), and MSI-high with stronger dependency (+0.743, lower +0.503; R201). Within MYC-amplification cells, the same core predictors remained threshold-robust: SMARCA4 loss stronger (+0.791, lower +0.636; R203), TP53 loss weaker (+0.676, lower +0.443; R204), and KEAP1 loss weaker (+0.901, lower +0.725; R205). Because PTEN has been examined across many correlated co-mutation and molecular contexts and the voluntary validation budget is exhausted, I retain PTEN loss as a secondary association with unresolved context dependence rather than promoting it to a broad threshold-robust overall claim.\n\nNegative dataset-specific findings include no scientifically meaningful dependency_composite differences for KRAS mutation (R1), STK11 main effect (R3), MYC amplification main effect (R6), PIK3CA mutation (R38), ARID1A main effect (R17), MTAP main effect and MTAP in CDKN2A-loss cells (R18, R79, R154), RB1 loss (R21), SMAD4 loss (R22), NF1 loss (R57), BRCA2 loss (R55), BRAF V600E (R59), EGFR amplification (R60, R106), ERBB2 amplification (R61), APC mutation and APC interaction by WNT activity (R58, R128), research markers D/E/F positivity (R7, R8, R54), omics-availability indicators (R28, R77, R76), CRISPR-library main effects (R9, R62, R75), media-serum main-effect contrasts (R63, R196, R197), and screen batch (R115). CDKN2A loss is not a broadly accepted stronger-dependency effect; its favorable main effect R19 had lower bound +0.062, and most subgroup or interaction contexts were unresolved or rejected. record.narrative: Final synthesis: no new validation was delivered, no response deadline is open, and assessments_due is empty, so the accepted claim set is unchanged and no new voluntary validation can be requested. The most defensible interpretation is a dataset-specific association map in the supplied composite dependency-score population, not a causal map and not an external generalization claim. More negative dependency_composite values mean stronger dependency; all signed estimates and intervals below are already oriented to the claimed hypothesis direction, and claims were treated as scientifically meaningful only when the signed lower bound exceeded +0.15 composite units. SMARCA4 loss is robustly associated with stronger composite dependency: discovery estimate +0.8325 with lower bound +0.7667 (R5), and independent validation estimate +0.7976 with lower bound +0.6971 (R13). TP53 loss is robustly associated with weaker composite dependency: discovery estimate +0.4232 with lower bound +0.3268 (R2), and independent validation estimate +0.3985 with lower bound +0.2633 (R39). KEAP1 loss is robustly associated with weaker composite dependency: discovery estimate +0.8315 with lower bound +0.7658 (R4), and independent validation estimate +0.7648 with lower bound +0.6687 (R92). MSI-high status is robustly associated with stronger composite dependency: discovery estimate +0.7918 with lower bound +0.6763 (R56), and independent validation estimate +0.7690 with lower bound +0.5936 (R78). A new accepted interaction is H207, the reversed TP53-loss interaction by high research_signature_A: signed estimate +0.7897 with lower bound +0.6214 (R208). This is a strong dataset-specific association involving a constructed assay, so it should be interpreted only as a statistical interaction within this dataset, not as causal biology or a validated pathway effect. Context-presistence also remains strong: in 2 percent serum, SMARCA4 loss remained stronger dependency (R199), TP53 loss weaker (R198), KEAP1 loss weaker (R200), and MSI-high stronger (R201); within MYC-amplification cells, SMARCA4 loss remained stronger (R203), TP53 loss weaker (R204), and KEAP1 loss weaker (R205). These are context-presence tests, not formal effect-modification claims. Negative findings are broad: KRAS mutation, STK11 main effect, MYC amplification main effect, PIK3CA mutation, ARID1A main effect, MTAP overall and MTAP in CDKN2A-loss cells, RB1 loss, SMAD4 loss, NF1 loss, BRCA2 loss, BRAF V600E, EGFR amplification, ERBB2 amplification, APC mutation, research markers D, E, and F, omics-availability indicators, CRISPR-library main effects, media-serum main-effect contrasts, screen batch, sex, and most formal interaction tests did not reach the 0.15 threshold in the claimed direction. The constructed-signature interaction screen mostly failed to support threshold-robust modifiers except H207; signature-A modifiers for SMARCA4, KEAP1, and MSI-high were rejected, signature-B SMARCA4 was rejected, and signature-C SMARCA4 remained unresolved but below threshold. Unresolved uncertainty is concentrated in low-power or repeatedly searched contexts: overall PTEN loss and key PTEN contexts H32, H111, and H124 remain borderline; low-power TP53-loss contexts H148, H151, H166, and H172 remain unresolved; several MYC amplification expression or copy-number contexts remain unresolved; KEAP1 interaction by adherent growth, CDKN2A secondary contexts, and H203 remain unresolved. Closing these was a multiplicity and resource decision, not proof of null. If confirmatory capacity were available, the most informative next analyses would be targeted independent validation of borderline PTEN contexts H111 and H124, plus overall PTEN H32, and low-power TP53 contexts H148, H151, H166, and H172; a pre-specified joint assessment of the core SMARCA4, TP53, KEAP1, and MSI-high associations with strict multiplicity control would be preferable to further arbitrary marker or subgroup mining.

refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.

Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

record.narrative: No assessments are due and the voluntary validation budget is exhausted, so this explore stage registers discovery hypotheses and closes H207 as an accepted but dataset-specific constructed-assay interaction. The main scientific need now is to test the core associations in more genetically isolated backgrounds and to ask whether a biologically motivated untested RNA marker, SLFN11, modifies those core associations. The four mean_difference proposals test SMARCA4 loss, TP53 loss, KEAP1 loss, and MSI-high status while excluding the other three accepted core predictors and STK11 loss. These are refinements of the core map, not new biological pathways: expected directions are the same as in the accepted core claims because the goal is to assess whether each robust association persists when co-occurring accepted drivers are absent. For SMARCA4 loss and MSI-high, the anticipated raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast is negative because more negative dependency_composite means stronger dependency; for TP53 loss and KEAP1 loss, the anticipated raw contrast is positive because those losses are associated with weaker dependency in this dataset. The four interaction proposals test whether high SLFN11 expression, above the observed median, amplifies the core effects. SLFN11 is a plausible DNA-damage and replication-stress marker, so if it marks biologically relevant stress states, it could magnify SMARCA4-loss and MSI-high stronger-dependency contrasts and magnify the TP53-loss and KEAP1-loss weaker-dependency contrasts. Plausible alternatives are no effect modification, attenuation of the core effect, or an opposite modification. I avoid further PTEN-loss or arbitrary signature-marker subgroup mining because PTEN has already been examined across many contexts, several lower bounds remain near but below threshold, and no confirmatory validation capacity remains. Future appraisal will accept only when the signed 95% lower bound exceeds +0.15 composite dependency-score units in the claimed direction; near-threshold findings will remain unresolved.

prompt:
Iteration 19/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Select up to 12 existing claim references in run_analyses. This requests analyses now; previously tested comparisons reuse their data and give no new sample. New results enter the ledger after this form is accepted and are assessed in appraise. Any assessment in this form must use evidence already in the supplied ledger.

prompt:
Iteration 19/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative: All due claims were screened against the stated scientific threshold of a signed lower bound > +0.15 composite dependency-score units in the claimed direction. The four isolated-core background tests support robust, dataset-specific persistence of the main associations. SMARCA4 loss remains associated with stronger dependency in cells without TP53, KEAP1, STK11, or MSI-high status: signed estimate +0.806, 95% lower +0.761 (R215). TP53 loss remains associated with weaker dependency in the isolated background: +0.418, lower +0.312 (R216). KEAP1 loss remains associated with weaker dependency: +0.812, lower +0.768 (R217). MSI-high remains associated with stronger dependency: +0.722, lower +0.637 (R218). All have adequate cell sizes. These are not independent validation and not causal or generalizable claims; eligibility restriction may itself select correlated biological states or induce selection artifacts, so the interpretation is that the core contrasts persist when other known core markers are absent. The four SLFN11-median-split interaction tests do not support claimed effect modification. H212 is slightly opposite the claimed SMARCA4 direction and not threshold-supporting (-0.069; R219). H213 is near null/opposite for TP53 (-0.008; R220). H214 is small, imprecise, and below threshold for KEAP1 (+0.041; R221). H215 is slightly opposite the claimed MSI-high direction (-0.062; R222). I reject and close these interaction tests rather than pursuing reversals, because the estimates are small and the search space of constructed or transcript-marker modifiers is already large. No validation request is made because the voluntary validation budget is exhausted. The broader conclusion remains a dataset-specific association map: SMARCA4-loss and MSI-high stronger dependency; TP53-loss and KEAP1-loss weaker dependency; with the newly accepted isolated-background refinements increasing confidence in the robustness of those associations within the supplied data, but not establishing biology outside this dataset.

Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without

prompt:
Iteration 20/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units

prompt:
Iteration 20/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- dependency_composite: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Select up to 12 existing claim references in run_analyses. This requests analyses now; previously tested comparisons reuse their data and give no new sample. New results enter the ledger after this form is accepted and are assessed in appraise. Any assessment in this form must use evidence already in the supplied ledger.

record.narrative: No assessments are due, no new validation can be requested because the voluntary validation budget is exhausted, and no scheduled validation has arrived. Therefore the analyze-stage action is to request all currently active, previously untested registered hypotheses: H216 through H227. These comparisons complete the set registered in the previous explore stage. Priorities are: (1) H226-H227, which test PTEN loss in genetically cleaner and lineage-restricted contexts to clarify whether PTEN is a secondary robust association or only context-dependent; (2) H225, which tests whether the accepted research_signature_A median-split interaction for TP53 loss persists at the 75th percentile; and (3) H216-H224, which are exploratory tests of whether the core associations persist in or are modified by AXL-high, ASCL2-high, and IFN-gamma-signature-high states. No previously tested comparisons are rerun, because rerunning cached evidence would not add a new sample. In appraise, each result will be judged on the supplied outcome scale: a finding is scientifically meaningful only if the signed estimate and 95% interval support an effect above 0.15 composite dependency-score units in the claimed direction, with adequate cell sizes. Estimates below threshold, opposite the claimed direction, or imprecise near threshold will be rejected or left unresolved, respectively. All conclusions remain dataset-specific associations, not causal claims or external generalizability.

Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

record.narrative: The new evidence primarily supports persistence of the core dependency-composite associations in transcript-expression states, while not supporting broad claimed effect modification by an AXL-high state. I evaluated each signed estimate against the outcome threshold of 0.15 composite dependency-score units, with the signed lower bound needed to clear that threshold. For H216 (R223), the SMARCA4-loss interaction with AXL-high status was small and imprecise: +0.070, 95% interval [-0.080, +0.221]. It does not support claimed effect modification. For H217 (R224), the claimed positive TP53-loss interaction was opposite the claimed direction: signed estimate -0.311, interval [-0.539, -0.083]. I reject the original positive-direction claim. I do not immediately adopt a reversed reversal claim: if the direction were reversed, the signed lower bound would only be +0.083, which does not clear the 0.15 threshold, and this was one of several post hoc interaction screens, so multiplicity caution is appropriate. H218 (R225) was small and imprecise for KEAP1-loss modification by AXL-high status: +0.033, interval [-0.114, +0.179]. These three AXL interaction tests are closed as not supporting the claimed effect modification. The AXL-high mean-difference test for MSI-high (H219/R226) nevertheless shows a clearly threshold-exceeding association: +0.722, lower bound +0.482, with exposed n=30. The sample is small in the exposed cell but above the 20-cell minimum, so I accept it as a dataset-specific persistence finding, not independent validation or a causal claim. In ASCL2-high top-quartile cells, all four core contrasts persist with strong lower bounds: SMARCA4-loss H220/R227 lower +0.632, TP53-loss H221/R228 lower +0.333, KEAP1-loss H222/R229 lower +0.631, and MSI-high H223/R230 lower +0.433. These acceptances strengthen the dataset-specific association map but remain subgroup associations in overlapping populations, not independent replicates. The IFN-gamma-signature-high MSI-high contrast H224/R231 is also threshold-supported: +0.817, lower +0.649. This supports persistence of MSI-high stronger dependency in an immune-signature-high context, but it does not establish immune causality. The refined research_signature_A TP53 interaction H225/R232 remains threshold-supported at the 75th percentile: +0.526, lower +0.306, though it should continue to be described as a constructed-assay statistical interaction, not biology. The PTEN-loss refinements H226/R233 and H227/R234 are scientifically suggestive but do not meet the strict lower-bound threshold: +0.224, lower +0.132 and +0.239, lower +0.133, respectively. I leave them unresolved rather than accepting, but I do not reject them, because the point estimates exceed the threshold and the intervals are compatible with effects just above threshold. These near-threshold contexts are consistent with PTEN-loss being a secondary, context-dependent association rather than a uniform overall effect; they do not override the stronger accepted PTEN findings in more restrictively defined non-MSI, non-KEAP1, non-SMARCA4, often TP53-wild-type or lineage-restricted subsets. No validation request is made because no new voluntary validation capacity remains.

Iteration 20/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released

These four form the strongest dataset-specific association map.

Context persistence. The core associations persisted in many non-independent subgroups, including lineage, culture/serum, ploidy, and transcript-state strata. Examples include persistence in ASCL2-high cells for SMARCA4 loss, TP53 loss, KEAP1 loss, and MSI-high, R227 through R230, persistence of MSI-high in IFN-gamma-signature-high cells, R231, and persistence of MSI-high in AXL-high cells, R226. These do not constitute independent replication, but they reduce the likelihood that the core findings are artifacts of a single extreme subgroup.

PTEN loss. PTEN loss is not a uniform overall association. The overall stronger-dependency claim is unresolved because R20 lower +0.131 and validated R119 lower +0.048 do not exclude effects below threshold. However, accepted cleaner-context comparisons support PTEN loss as a secondary context-dependent stronger-dependency association, for example R29 lower +0.169, R34 lower +0.169, R49 lower +0.165, R86 lower +0.172, R96 lower +0.227, R97 lower +0.151, R142 lower +0.196, and R151 lower +0.182. These contexts mostly remove or hold constant the major core drivers such as MSI-high, KEAP1 loss, SMARCA4 loss, and TP53 status. This supports a context-dependent PTEN effect, not a uniform overall effect.

Constructed-assay interaction. The strongest accepted interaction involves TP53 loss and research_signature_A. At the median split, signed +0.790, lower +0.621, R208; at the 75th-percentile refinement, signed +0.526, lower +0.306, R232. Because research signatures are constructed standardized assays and the interaction uses dichotomized subgroups, this should be interpreted only as a dataset-specific statistical interaction, not as biological pathway evidence or a generalizable biomarker.

Negative findings. Many common measured predictors did not show meaningful associations. These include KRAS R1, STK11 R3, MYC amplification R6, PIK3CA R38, ARID1A R17, MTAP R18 and R79, RB1 R21, SMAD4 R22, NF1 R57, BRCA2 R55, BRAF R59, EGFR R60 and R106, ERBB2 R61, APC R58 and R128, and constructed research markers D, E, and F, R7, R8, and R54. Technical and demographic contrasts also lacked meaningful effects: omics-availability indicators R28, R76, and R77; CRISPR library indicators R9, R62, and R75; media-serum contrasts R63, R196, and R197; screen batch R115 and R214; and sex R213. Most dichotomized effect-modification screens were rejected, including AXL-high interactions R223 through R225, SLFN11-median interactions R219 through R222, and several growth, screen-quality, CAS9, lineage, and research_signature_b interactions. R224 was opposite the claimed direction but was not adopted as a reversed claim because the reversed lower bound was below the 0.15 threshold and the screen context warranted multiplicity caution.

Unresolved uncertainty. Several claims remain unresolved because point estimates exceed the threshold but intervals do not confidently place the effect above 0.15. These include overall PTEN R20 and R119, near-threshold PTEN contexts such as R109 and R130, R131 and R141, R233, and R234; low-power TP53-loss subsets such as R156, R158, R174, and R180; some CDKN2A contexts such as R30, R89, R90, and R127; some constructed-assay or expression interactions such as R211 and R129; and the KEAP1 adherent interaction R139. Comparisons invalidated by insufficient cell sizes, such as R84, R85, and R126, are not scientific evidence.

Final scientific conclusion. The best supported dataset-specific association map is that SMARCA4 loss and MSI-high are associated with more negative dependency scores, i.e. stronger dependency; TP53 loss and KEAP1 loss are associated with less negative scores, i.e. weaker dependency; PTEN loss is a secondary context-dependent association consistent with stronger dependency in genetically cleaner backgrounds; and research_signature_A strongly modifies the observed TP53-loss association. These are associations in this dataset only, not causal dependencies, not biological mechanism, and not guaranteed to generalize.

Most informative next analysis. If confirmatory capacity becomes available, the next analysis should not be broad post hoc subgroup mining. The highest-value plan is a small pre-specified confirmatory panel of SMARCA4 loss, TP53 loss, KEAP1 loss, and MSI-high with strict multiplicity control and lower-bound decision rules at 0.15; targeted validation of the unresolved overall PTEN claim and the cleaner PTEN contexts corresponding to R109, R130, R131, R141, R233, and R234; continuous and covariate-adjusted interaction models for research_signature_A with TP53 loss and for co-occurring mutation effects; and adequately powered tests of low-power TP53-loss subsets only if cell sizes can satisfy the minimum-comparison-cell requirement.",

Accepted core map: SMARCA4 loss and MSI-high stronger dependency, validated by R5/R13 and R56/R78; TP53 loss and KEAP1 loss weaker dependency, validated by R2/R39 and R4/R92. Unresolved areas include borderline PTEN contexts, low-power TP53-loss subsets, some CDKN2A and constructed-assay interactions, and invalid insufficient-cell comparisons. Comparisons invalidated by insufficient cell sizes, such as R84, R85, and R126, are not scientific evidence.

Final scientific conclusion. The best supported dataset-specific association map is that SMARCA4 loss and MSI-high are associated with more negative dependency scores, i.e. stronger dependency; TP53 loss and KEAP1 loss are associated with less negative scores, i.e. weaker dependency; PTEN loss is a secondary context-dependent association consistent with stronger dependency in genetically cleaner backgrounds; and research_signature_A strongly modifies the observed TP53-loss association. These are associations in this dataset only, not causal dependencies, not biological mechanism, and not guaranteed to generalize.

Most informative next analysis. If confirmatory capacity becomes available, the next analysis should not be broad post hoc subgroup mining. record.narrative: No assessments are due and voluntary validation capacity is exhausted, so this explore stage registers targeted discovery follow-ups rather than broad post hoc mining. The accepted dataset-specific map remains SMARCA4-loss and MSI-high associated with stronger dependency, and TP53-loss and KEAP1-loss associated with weaker dependency. Proposals 1-3 ask whether these core associations persist within the median-high research_signature_A stratum, while also providing absolute effect estimates rather than only interaction contrasts. I expect SMARCA4-loss and MSI-high raw contrasts to remain negative and KEAP1-loss to remain positive, with null attenuation or reversal plausible. Proposals 4-5 directly examine the stratified TP53-loss mean differences implied by the accepted research_signature_A interaction: the high-signature top quartile may show a reversed stronger-dependency effect if the accepted interaction reflects a true dose-response-like statistical association, whereas the low-signature bottom quartile may show the conventional weaker-dependency effect. These remain constructed-assay statistical comparisons, not biological claims. Proposals 6-10 focus on PTEN loss, whose overall effect is unresolved but cleaner-context evidence suggests a secondary stronger-dependency association. I test PTEN loss in a genetically clean background excluding MSI-high, TP53 loss, KEAP1 loss, and SMARCA4 loss, split by high versus low mutation burden; directly test whether mutation burden modifies the PTEN effect in that clean background; test whether STK11 loss modifies PTEN in that same clean background; and estimate PTEN effect in the fully STK11-wildtype clean background. Expected raw PTEN effects are negative if the stronger-dependency context-dependent association persists, but null or attenuated effects are important alternatives. Acceptance in later stages will require signed lower bounds exceeding 0.15 composite dependency-score units; near-threshold results should remain unresolved, especially given accumulated subgroup screening multiplicity. All claims remain association claims in this supplied dataset, not causal or generalizable claims.

Iteration 21/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in dependency_composite (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (research_signature_a, research_signature_b, research_signature_c) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (research_marker_d_positive, research_marker_e_positive, research_marker_f_positive) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.

and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.

multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.
